environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind an API Gateway WebSocket API configured with endpoint_type PRIVATE and associated with a VPC Interface Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) via resource policy. The API Gateway resource policy contains an explicit Deny for any request where aws:SourceVpce does not match vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The VPC (vpc-0xf8a3b2c1d) has no Internet Gateway, no NAT Gateway, and no VPC peering connections. DNS resolution for the execute-api endpoint resolves only to private IPs (10.0.47.x range) within the VPC via Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint. The VPC endpoint policy further restricts to execute-api:Invoke on the specific API ID only. Security group sg-0abc123def456 on the VPC endpoint ENIs allows inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.32.0/20 (application subnet). No public DNS name is published or resolvable outside the VPC.

config.vpce_policy: Allow execute-api:Invoke on specific API ID only
